note: P2.2 packet seed. Controlled vocabulary for entity matching; anything that survives alias normalization without matching a label becomes an entity candidate (status: proposed) and never auto-enters entities.json. Seats are empty at seed by design: DUN/Parliament codes come from data/canonical/dun and geo, not news text. Sources are the top-20 'source' values visible in ge16-news-accepted.json by frequency.

PPBM.note: Historic registration name (Parti Pribumi Bersatu Malaysia).

matching.rule: A string matches when its normalized form equals any seed label (any type) or alias key; matched strings create no candidates. Unmatched strings become candidates typed by the field they appeared in.
